newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile smelter expansion study ready Dec - report.
newsitem.headline: Chile smelter expansion study ready Dec - report.

text.p: A feasibility study for the expansion of the Refimet copper smelter in northern Chile will be completed in December, reported newspaper El Diario.
The paper, quoting Refimet president Alfonso Dulanto, said the expansion would boost production by 140,000 tonnes of copper blister and anodes a year.
If the project goes ahead, Refimet's processing capacity will rise to 700,000 tonnes of copper concentrates, equivalent of 280,000 tonnes of fine copper.
Dulanto said early calculations showed the scheme will involve an investment of around $70 million.
Refimet is controlled by Chilean investors with stakes held by Canadian mining companies Noranda and Barrick Gold.
